text:
Ari: morning team  having an odd SSO/provisioning day. Okta says "No app assigned" when i try to open Google Workspace, 1Password invite arrived but says link expired, and TOTP enrollment throws "external server not responding". first day jitters. anyone?
Sam (IT): hey ari, welcome! can you confirm the email you used to sign up (work vs alias)? i can quickly check group assignments and resend 1Password.
Ari: used ari+redwood@personal.com (i know, i should've used work alias). my work alias is ari@redwood.ai but i clicked the invite link from my personal inbox.
Sam (IT): ok show me the email address and i'll check. quick note: TOTP often fails if system clock is off. on linux you can run `timedatectl` to verify. also resending 1Password invite now.
Ari: timedatectl says
Ari: ```
Local time: Tue 2026-03-17 09:12:04 -07
NTP synchronized: yes
RTC in local TZ: no
```
Ari: still seeing the TOTP error though.
Marcos (eng-infra): fyi, corporate VPN/wireguard can sometimes rewrite headers or intercept traffic and Okta rejects the enrollment. are you on VPN?
Ari: aha yes i'm on WG to access a client environment. turning it off and retrying...
Ari: TOTP enrollment succeeded after disabling WireGuard. thanks Marcos!
Sam (IT): great. i also noticed your account was provisioned under the personal email alias which explains the expired 1P link. i'll map the personal alias to your canonical work account and run a manual group sync so you get the Google Workspace app.
onboarding-bot: 1Password invite resent to ari@redwood.ai at 1861009901.
Ari: invite came through to the work email, accepted. when i try passkey enrollment on Safari i get "Authenticator not allowed"; switched to Chrome and that worked (registered as "ari-usbkey").
Lisa (onboarding): quick onboarding tip: if you used an email alias when accepting invites, ping IT to ensure the alias maps to your org account. saving this to the checklist. :memo:
Sam (IT): mapping updated and you are now in the "engineers" group. i pushed a manual directory sync; you should be able to sign into Google, Slack, and internal docs.
Ari: confirmed google and slack access working. 1Password accepted, TOTP and passkey both set. SSH pubkey uploaded via support ticket and works. thanks everyone!
Sam (IT): marked resolved. welcome to Redwood! :tada:
